payout_quote: Ford Rewards members who are new cardholders earn a 15,000 Point bonus (up to a $75 redemption value) after making just one purchase with their new Ford Rewards Visa in the first 90 days after opening their card.
steps: Enroll free in the Ford Rewards program (FordRewards.com or the Ford app)
Apply and be approved for the Ford Rewards Visa Signature Card (issued by Comenity Capital Bank, $0 annual fee)
Make one purchase with the new card within 90 days of account opening
15,000 Ford Rewards Points (up to $75 redemption value toward Ford service and more) are awarded
catches: Points redeemable toward Ford service, parts, and accessories - Ford-ecosystem credit, not cash
'Up to a $75 redemption value' - actual value depends on redemption choice
Offer expires 12/31/2026; valid one time only; U.S. territories excluded
Credit approval required; application triggers a hard inquiry
Never spend extra just to chase the bonus - one purchase means any purchase, but do not manufacture spending
Annual-fee net math: $0 annual fee, so the $75 is net of fees - as long as you pay in full
Balance-carrying/APR risk: high variable APR wipes the bonus if a balance is carried - pay the statement balance in full
biggest_catch: The 15,000 points lock value inside the Ford ecosystem (service/parts) - only real money if you already service a Ford.
eligibility: Ford Rewards member (free); approved for the Ford Rewards Visa Signature Card; new cardholder
timing: Bonus paid after the 90-day qualification window; offer expires 12/31/2026.
